environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer (internet-facing). Security group allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. The ALB forwards to port 8080 on the container. No WAF rules attached. Container runs as root with read-write filesystem. Route table has an internet gateway route (0.0.0.0/0 -> igw-xxx).
